item.title: Mob attacks failure of govt to address impunity: Irene Khan
item.description: UN expert Irene Khan said in a statement on Tuesday that the mob attacks on leading media outlets and cultural centres in Bangladesh are deeply alarming and must be investigated promptly and effectively by the government, and the perpetrators brought to justice without delay. item.title: Zaima recalls childhood memories with grandma
item.description: Barrister Zaima Rahman, daughter of BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman, shared an emotional Facebook post with a childhood photo of herself sitting on her grandmother BNP Chairman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia's lap.In the post, she wrote about her memories, life experiences and hopes for the future.A day after the post, Zaima returned home with her parents after 17 years. item.title: 5-day remand for Faisal's associate
item.description: A Dhaka court on Tuesday granted a five-day remand for Kabir, a close associate of prime accused Faisal Karim Masud, in the murder case of Sharif Osman Hadi, spokesperson of Inqilab Moncho and a potential independent candidate for the Dhaka-8 constituency.Dhaka Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Sefatullah passed the order after hearing a petition filed by Detective Branch (DB) Inspector Faisal Ahmed. item.title: Indonesia cricketer becomes first to take five wickets in one over in a T20
item.description: Indonesia cricketer Gede Priandana became the first player to take five wickets in one over in a Twenty20 international on Tuesday.The seamer, who also opens the batting, was bowling in Bali against Cambodia, which was on 106-5.Priandana began by dismissing opener Shah Abrar Hussain for 37 on his way to a hat trick.He followed with a dot ball then dismissed the last two batters either side of a wide, the only run in the over.Cambodia was all out for 107.Priandana has 24 wickets in T20s.He scored

item.title: Libya's top military chief killed in plane crash in Turkey
item.description: The head of Libya's armed forces and four other high ranking military officials died late Tuesday when their business jet crashed shortly after taking off from Ankara, officials in Turkey's capital and Tripoli said.The wreckage of their Falcon 50 aircraft was located by Turkish security personnel in the Haymana district near Ankara, Turkish Interior Minister Ali Yerlikaya said. item.title: Govt reduces customs duty on date imports by 40pc

item.title: VAT exemption on Metro Rail services extended for 6-month
